---
title: "FAO OpenEO Documentation"
---

The FAO OpenEO backend provides access to Earth observation data and analytical processes through the [OpenEO API v1.2.0](https://openeo.org/). Connect to the backend at [`data.fao.org/openeo`](https://data.fao.org/openeo) using the Python client or the [Web Editor](https://data.fao.org/editor/?server=data.fao.org%2Fopeneo).

## Running Notebooks Locally

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt jupyter
jupyter notebook tutorials/
```

Authenticate via OIDC (FAO Single Sign-On) when prompted.
